Ava (CEO): Quick follow-up after the Q&A: we had multiple questions about how free credits, reserved capacity, and transient burst allowances interact during a product launch. Who owns the guidance and what's the short playbook we can point teams to?

Samir (VP Product): Short version: credits = dollar offset only, reserved capacity = contractual throughput + SLA, burst = short token-bucket allowance on top of quotas. For launches you should 1) request Launch Support, 2) pick fallbacks, 3) decide on invoice vs platform credit.

Jamie (Finance): Important: platform credits do not change quotas. If a customer needs higher throughput and also wants a credit, treat those as separate ops: Finance issues credit, Product/Eng approves quota delta or reserved slot.

Riley (Support): Operational checklist we ask for on triage: account ID, expected window (tz), peak RPS, endpoints affected, SDK/language, auth sample, and fallback plan. If urgent, use hotline. Template: https://console.redwood.example.com/launch-form

DevOpsBot: System note: default read/write QPS per account = 80/40. Burst: token-bucket +30% for 60s. Admin temp quota endpoint: POST /admin/v1/temp_quota_request returns request_id; requires two approvers or auto-reject.

Carlos (SRE): During previous launches we saw client retry storms amplify pressure. Recommend adding guidance: limit client retries to 3, use exponential backoff + jitter, and prefer streaming/resume where possible. Also instrument with request_id for tracing.

Maya (PM): Action items: I'll own a one-page "Launch Ops" card for the console (quick rules, who to contact, form link, billing note). Riley, can Support add the canned triage reply? Samir, can you confirm gating criteria for auto-approve vs manual?

Riley (Support): Yep, I'll add canned replies and a Slack shortcut that pre-fills the form.

Samir (VP Product): Auto-approve threshold: <= 50% above base QPS for <= 10 minutes and risk_score < 40. Anything else is manual review. I'll put this in the docs and share a short FAQ blurb.

Jamie (Finance): I'll write the billing blurb: credits do not affect quotas; invoice credits can be issued for overages if Sales approves. Include contact: billing@redwood.example.com.

Ava (CEO): Good. Prioritize the console card + canned support reply. We want Sales/CS to know the exact gating rules so we don't surprise customers. Thanks all. Thread closing in 24h unless someone objects. :rocket:
